page.layout: Top: running head "THEOD. BEZÆ" centred above a heading "IISDEM." and a verse epigram with large initial Q (full width). Below: a rule, then heading "SIMONIS GRYNÆI; MAGNI cognome..." (full width, justified) and a poem of verse lines with large initial E (full width). One column, no margin notes.

main_text.l: IISDEM.
QVum tumulo lateat Melior Volmarius isto,
Cui Margarita adest comes,
Est illi curinuideas, Mausole, diuque
Celebrata Pyramidum struēs,
Næquenihil melius Meliore, nec India quidquā
Fert Margarita carius.
SIMONIS GRYNÆI; MA-
GNI cognome in omni eruditionis ge-
nere adepti: bonarum artium in Aca-
demia Basilienfi Profefforis, Memoriæ.
ECquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Nympha,
Tingitis imbre genas largo, Rhenūq; per omne
Turbata, magno repletis littora planctu?
Ecquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Phœbe,
Sublatum esse gemis, quæ par tibi cura sodalem
Fecerat, & simile adiunctum cognome Vtrique?
Ecquid nunc iaculatur aquas nimbosus Orion?
Et madidam fundit lacrymosus Aquarius
urnā? Caterāque obscuro radiantia sidera cælo
Illustres tingunt nigra ferrugine vultus?
Ecquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Vates
Deiecti mœrore oculos, lacrymantia verba,
Et mœsto alternos trahitis de pectore versus?
O rerum fortes varia, properatáque doctis
Semper

page.notes: Lower half of the first verse column and the lower-left Latin lines are partly obscured by a strike-through and stains; "lacrymosus" and "Aquarius" read with some uncertainty. The woodcut-style large initials Q and E are joined to their words. The bottom line "Semper" is set right-aligned.
